welcome.title: 🏸 Welcome to CLUB Scheduler
welcome.content: CLUB Scheduler helps badminton clubs organise fair, balanced sessions. It tracks ratings, match history, and lets you manage multiple clubs across three modes: Player, Organiser, and Club Manager.
welcome.tip: Start by signing in — tap Get Started on the welcome screen and enter your email to receive a one-time code.

sign_in.title: 🔑 Signing In
list: Tap 'Get Started' on the welcome screen
Enter your email address
Check your email for a 6-digit code
Enter the code to sign in
You stay signed in — no need to sign in again each time
sign_in.tip: Use the same email every time — your profile, clubs, and ratings are all linked to it.

modes.title: 🎛️ Three Modes — Player, Organiser, Club Manager
modes.content: After signing in you choose a mode from the mode selection screen. Each mode gives you a different home screen.
list: 🏸 Player — view slots, live sessions, your card and ratings
🏸 Organiser — run sessions, manage players, generate rounds
🔒 Vault — manage your club: register players, handle join requests
modes.tip: Tap the mode title at the top or the ✕ button to switch modes anytime.

first_session.title: 🚀 Running Your First Session
steps: 1. Select Organiser mode from the mode screen
2. Connect to your club via the Club tile
3. Go to Players — add players present today
4. Tap Go > in the stepper to move to Pairs, Courts, Rounds
5. On the Rounds page tap New Round to generate courts
6. After each game record W or L
7. Repeat until session is done, then tap End Session

rating_explained.title: ⭐ How Ratings Work
rating_explained.content: Every player starts at rating 1.0. Ratings go up when you win and down when you lose. The change depends on opponent strength.
list: 1.0 – 1.9 → Rookie
3.0 – 3.9 → Competitive
4.0 – 4.4 → Advanced
4.5+ → Elite
rating_explained.tip: You have a Global Rating (across all clubs) and a Club Rating (for this club only).

add_players_tabs.title: ➕ Adding Players — Browse, Favorites, Type
add_players_tabs.content: The Add Players panel has three tabs:
list: 🔍 Browse — search your club or all players and tap to select
⭐ Favorites — saved sets of players for quick reuse
✏️ Type — type new player names directly
add_players_tabs.tip: Use Browse to import existing club members, Type to add a brand new player.

player_rows.title: 👥 Player List
player_rows.content: Each row shows one player. The colour indicates gender.
list: Checkbox ticked → player is active (will be scheduled)
Checkbox unticked → player is resting (skipped this session)
Tap the star to save a player to Favorites
Tap the trash icon to remove from this session

courts_rule.title: 🎾 Courts & Player Count
list: 4 active players = 1 court
8 active players = 2 courts
12 active players = 3 courts
Every 4 players = 1 additional court
courts_rule.note: Gender does not affect the number of courts.

troubleshooting.title: 🔧 Common Issues
list: Can't generate a round? — You need at least 4 active players
Player not being scheduled? — Check their checkbox is ticked
Wrong gender shown? — Edit the player in Vault → Modify

generating_rounds.title: 🔄 Generating Rounds
generating_rounds.content: Tap 'New Round' to automatically generate fair court assignments. The system balances pairings so everyone plays with different partners over time.
generating_rounds.tip: The scheduler tracks who has played with and against whom to keep matchups fresh.

courts_layout.title: 🏸 Court Layout
list: Each row = one court
Each court has 2 teams of 2 players
Left team vs Right team
Players not on a court are resting this round

recording_results.title: ✅ Recording Results
recording_results.content: After each game tap W (Win) or L (Loss) for each court. This updates ratings immediately.
list: W = the left team won
L = the right team won
Results sync to all club members in real time
recording_results.tip: Record results before generating the next round — results affect how the next round is balanced.

lock_unlock.title: 🔒 Lock / Unlock Round
list: Locked — no manual player swaps allowed
Unlocked — you can swap players between courts
Auto-rotation still works even when locked
lock_unlock.note: Lock the round once you are happy with the court assignments.

swapping_players.title: 🔄 Swapping Players
list: 1. Unlock the round first
2. Tap the player you want to move
3. Tap the player to swap with (another court or from resting)
4. Swap happens immediately
swapping_players.tip: Use swaps to balance a lopsided court or handle last-minute player changes.

resting_players.title: 💤 Resting Players
resting_players.content: Players not on a court this round are resting. The number next to their name shows how many rounds they have rested.
resting_players.tip: The scheduler prioritises resting players in the next round to keep things fair.

what_is_vault.title: 🔒 What is Vault?
what_is_vault.content: Vault is the club management mode. It gives you three tools:
list: 📋 Register — view all players registered to your club
✏️ Modify — edit player details such as name, gender, and rating
🔔 Requests — approve or reject join requests from new members
what_is_vault.tip: Vault requires a Pro subscription or admin access.

register.title: 📋 Register Tab
register.content: Shows all players currently registered to your club.
list: Search by name to find a specific player
Tap a player to view their profile
Player count shown at the top

modify.title: ✏️ Modify Tab
modify.content: Edit any player's details in your club.
list: Tap a player to open the edit panel
Change name, gender, or club rating
Changes sync immediately to all devices
modify.note: Only Vault users can modify player details.

requests.title: 🔔 Join Requests
requests.content: When a new user joins your club they appear here for approval.
list: Approve → player is linked to their account
Reject → request is removed
NEW badge shows when there are pending requests
requests.tip: Check Requests regularly so new members are not kept waiting.

creating_club.title: 🏟️ Creating a Club
list: Select Organiser mode
Tap the Club tile → tap Create
Enter a club name and passwords
Share the join password with members
Keep the admin password private
creating_club.note: The admin password cannot be recovered if lost. Keep it safe.

joining_club.title: 🤝 Joining a Club
list: Select Player or Club Manager mode
Tap My Clubs on the home screen
Tap Join Club and enter the club name and password
Your request goes to the Vault admin for approval
Once approved you are a full member
joining_club.tip: You can join multiple clubs and switch between them from the My Clubs tile.

switching_clubs.title: 🔁 Switching Clubs
switching_clubs.content: If you belong to multiple clubs you can switch the active club from the My Clubs tile on the home screen.
switching_clubs.tip: Each club has its own Club Rating — your Global Rating is shared across all clubs.

club_management.title: 🏢 Club Management
club_management.content: From Organiser mode tap the Club tile to access:
list: Connect — join an existing club
Create — start a new club
Delete — remove a club you admin

what_is_viewer.title: 🏸 Player Mode
what_is_viewer.content: Player mode is for members who want to view and join slots, check their card, and follow live sessions.
list: My Card — see your own profile, rating, and match history
Dashboard — watch live courts and scores in real time
My Clubs — switch clubs or join a new one
Report — view monthly stats for your club
what_is_viewer.tip: Player mode is available to all members. No subscription required.

my_card.title: 👤 My Card
my_card.content: Your personal profile shows your current ratings and match history.
list: Global Rating — your rating across all clubs
Club Rating — your rating in this specific club
Win / Loss record for this club
Recent session history

dashboard_viewer.title: 📡 Dashboard
dashboard_viewer.content: The Dashboard shows all live and recent sessions for your club.
list: LIVE badge — session is currently active
Tap a session to see court details
Scores update in real time
dashboard_viewer.tip: You can watch any live session even if you are not playing.

trial.title: ⏳ Free Trial
trial.content: New accounts get a 60-day free trial with full access to all features including Organiser and Vault modes.
trial.tip: A trial banner shows in Settings so you can track how many days remain.

plans.title: ⚡ Subscription Plans
plans.content: After the trial ends you need a plan to continue using Organiser and Club Manager modes. Player mode remains free.
list: 1 Month — 30 days
6 Months — 180 days
1 Year — 365 days
Lifetime — no expiry
plans.tip: Contact your club admin or visit the license portal to subscribe.

restore.title: ♻️ Restoring Your Plan
restore.content: If you reinstall the app or sign in on a new device your plan is restored automatically when you sign in with the same email.
restore.note: Make sure to use the same email address you subscribed with.

tile_style.title: 🎨 Tile Style
tile_style.content: Change how the home screen tiles look. Three styles available:
list: Flat — clean minimal look using your current theme colours
Glow — dark surface tiles with a coloured glowing top border
Color — each tile gets a distinct solid accent colour
tile_style.tip: Tile style works in both Dark and Light mode.

theme.title: 🌙 Dark / Light Theme
theme.content: Switch between Dark and Light theme from Settings. All screens and tiles adapt automatically.
theme.tip: Dark mode is easier on the eyes in a dimly lit gym.

language.title: 🌐 Language
language.content: The app supports multiple languages. Change your language from Settings.
list: English
Japanese (日本語)
Korean (한국어)
Chinese (中文)
Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt)

logout.title: 🚪 Sign Out
logout.content: You can sign out from the Settings page. Your data is saved to the cloud — signing back in restores everything.
logout.note: Signing out clears your local session. You will need to sign in again with your email.

offline.title: 📶 Does It Work Offline?
offline.content: The app shell loads offline. However syncing ratings, saving session history, and loading club data all require internet.
offline.tip: Always ensure you have a connection before ending a session.

ratings_not_updating.title: ⭐ My Rating Is Not Updating
list: Make sure you recorded W or L for the round
Check your internet connection
Ratings update after each round is scored
Re-open the app to force a refresh

session_lost.title: 😟 I Closed the App Mid-Session
session_lost.content: Live session data is saved to the cloud every round. When you reopen the app the session resumes automatically.
session_lost.tip: Sign in before playing so the system knows who you are and can link your results.

auto_end.title: ⏱️ Session Ended Automatically
auto_end.content: If no rounds are scored for 1 hour the session ends automatically. All data is saved before it closes.
auto_end.note: This prevents sessions from being accidentally left open overnight.

multiple_devices.title: 📱 Using Multiple Devices
multiple_devices.content: The app works across multiple devices in the same club.
list: Live session visible from any device in Player or Organiser mode
Only the session starter or admin can End Session
Ratings sync automatically after each round

cache_old_version.title: 🔄 App Showing Old Version
cache_old_version.content: The app always fetches fresh files when online. If you still see an old version:
list: Make sure you have an internet connection
Close and reopen the app
On Safari: Settings → Safari → Clear History and Website Data
On Chrome: DevTools → Application → Clear site data
cache_old_version.tip: This should only be needed once — after that updates happen automatically.
